Thought in dialogue

Essays by Alessandro Gentili

Essay 01 · 1999: la paura di diventare uguali (in Italian)

Interpretive connection. In «La soglia che ritorna», consumer culture teaches us to confuse desire with need and to measure freedom by the choices on offer. The guide to Epicurus asks what prepares the choice: how we learn to regard something we want as something we must have.

Essay 21 · Da che parte sta chi guarda (in Italian)

Interpretive connection. In «La fatica di scriversi», judgment takes shape in part through hours of study when thought has no audience. The guide’s contemporary wound raises a question beside those hours: what happens to our measure of enough when recognition from others keeps raising it?

Related triad

Triad IX · Desire, relation, judgment

Epicurus asks how to measure desire. Tarde shows how desires take shape in social relations, and Kahneman studies how the framing of a problem shapes a decision. The triad asks how much of a choice takes shape before we decide.
